accepted.sentence: Regular rides provide aerobic exercise that can strengthen the heart and improve endurance without requiring access to a gym.
Guided sightseeing tours let visitors explore historic neighborhoods at a leisurely pace while stopping easily at points of interest.
Postal workers can carry letters and small parcels along neighborhood routes, reaching homes where vehicle access is inconvenient.
Officers use quiet, maneuverable transport to patrol parks and crowded public events where motor vehicles may be impractical.
Young children can practice steering and balance on small models, building coordination before learning to ride independently.
In rural areas, pedal-powered travel can connect residents with schools, clinics, and shops when public transit is limited.
Some people use hand-powered models to travel independently when leg movement is limited, supporting everyday outings and social participation.
